newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador's Daglio denies coffee bankrupt rumors.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador's Daglio denies coffee bankrupt rumors.

text.p: A spokesman for Salvadoran coffee exporters Daglio y Cia denied on Tuesday that the trading firm had gone bankrupt.
"We have an economic crisis, but we are not in bankruptcy," Lorena Zablah told Reuters in answer to questions on the financial viability of the 100-year-old company.
"Sales are down and like any other company we have problems and for that reason we are looking for financing," she said, declining to enter into details.
Zablah said Daglio director Ronald Anthor was not going to be in the country until the weekend to expand on the company's situation.
"It is ironic that with prices so high that these problems emerge, but I am sure we will come out of it," she added.
